reason: $36 for a tinted lip balm is more than I'll pay when I can get something similar for $10 to $20 at the drugstore. Even the two-for-$59 deal still works out to almost $30 each, and that's no bargain to me.
objection: The price. It's a brand I've never heard of with no reviews, and I'd be paying double or triple what the usual balms cost. The year-long guarantee is nice, but I don't want the bother of mailing things back.
would_change_my_mind: A real buy-one-get-one offer that brings it to about $18 a tube, plus some reviews from women my age.
